description: Checks whether the YAFL share link at the given `url` is still live — live, uploading, expired, or not found — without downloading or decrypting anything. Returns liveness, size, and expiry only. Does not read the decryption key even if present in the URL fragment, and never fetches any file bytes.

url.description: A YAFL share URL, e.g. https://yafl.dev/t/{id}#{key} (the fragment/key is ignored by this tool)

name: get_status
title: Get Transfer Status
